survivalTip: Do the homework the night it is assigned, don't wait until the day before the test.
SparkNotes helps, but actually reading the book makes the essays 10x easier.
Time management is crucial. Do your homework on the bus!
Memorize loads of transitional words, it will help connect your thoughts!
Understand concepts during class rather than trying to at home.
Don't just memorize the theorums and postulates. Apply them to practice problem so you don't get confused on a test.
Don't wait until the night before a test to study. Bio has a lot of small details, so reviewing a little at a time makes studying less overwhelming.

Keep a running list of vocabulary and phrases you forget and practice them. The first level of a language is your foundation, so if you don't build a strong foundation, it can make everything you learn later harder to understand.
